description: This file contains functions for unmarshaling Protocol Buffer messages, including handling of various data types such as custom types, time, duration, and slices, with specific focus on the gogo/protobuf implementation.

methods.name: makeUnmarshalMessage
methods.description: Creates a function to unmarshal a message field from protobuf bytes, handling nil pointers and merging submessages.

methods.name: makeUnmarshalMessageSlice
methods.description: Creates a function to unmarshal repeated message fields, appending to slices.

methods.name: makeUnmarshalCustomPtr
methods.description: Creates a function to unmarshal custom interface types via their Unmarshal method.

methods.name: makeUnmarshalCustomSlice
methods.description: Creates a function to unmarshal slices of custom interface types.

methods.name: makeUnmarshalCustom
methods.description: Creates a function to unmarshal custom interface types directly into pointers.

methods.name: makeUnmarshalTime
methods.description: Creates a function to unmarshal timestamp protobuf messages into time.Time values.

methods.name: makeUnmarshalTimePtr
methods.description: Creates a function to unmarshal timestamp protobuf messages into *time.Time values.

methods.name: makeUnmarshalTimePtrSlice
methods.description: Creates a function to unmarshal timestamp protobuf messages into slices of *time.Time.

methods.name: makeUnmarshalTimeSlice
methods.description: Creates a function to unmarshal timestamp protobuf messages into slices of time.Time.

methods.name: makeUnmarshalDurationPtr
methods.description: Creates a function to unmarshal duration protobuf messages into *duration.

methods.name: makeUnmarshalDuration
methods.description: Creates a function to unmarshal duration protobuf messages into duration.

methods.name: makeUnmarshalDurationPtrSlice
methods.description: Creates a function to unmarshal duration protobuf messages into slices of *duration.

methods.name: makeUnmarshalDurationSlice
methods.description: Creates a function to unmarshal duration protobuf messages into slices of duration.
